articles.author: Jared Kirui
articles.description:
Polymarket and Parcl are moving real estate into onchain prediction markets, creating a new venue where traders can  
speculate on the direction of housing prices without touching physical property  
or long-term mortgages. 
The integration links Polymarket’s event-based markets  
with Parcl’s independently published, daily home price indices, reportedly enabling  
faster, rules-based settlement of contracts tied to major U.S. housing markets.
Under the partnership, Polymarket will list and  
operate a new suite of housing-focused prediction markets, while Parcl will  
supply the independent index data and final settlement values.

Real Estate Markets are officially live on @Polymarket 🏠Predict home values, exclusively powered by Parcl data. pic.twitter.com/AGj1WKUGRC
— Parcl (@Parcl) Jan…
articles.title: U.S. Home Prices Become Tradeable Events as Polymarket Taps Parcl Data
